about.title: About us
about.lead: Tres Ceibas is a community in Villa Magante, Dominican Republic, with many of its sons and daughters living abroad.
about.body: We organize to bring people together and strengthen our cultural, religious and sports traditions. Since we have no recreation space of our own today, we want to buy land for a community club, where young people and families can gather in a healthy environment.
about.transparencyBody: Every donation is recorded and added to the total you see on this site. Gifts are used only for the purposes described in each project, which are non-profit.

footer.made: Made with love by and for the Tres Ceibas community.
